passage:
Kwame Mensah (10:02 A.M.)
Hi Aiko, I'm at Lakeside Mall picking up the new printer for our shop. The store has the model we wanted, but only in gray, not white.

Aiko Takeda (10:04 A.M.)
Gray is fine. Is it still on sale?

Kwame Mensah (10:05 A.M.)
Yes, it's $40 off until Sunday. The clerk also said they can deliver it tomorrow at no charge.

Aiko Takeda (10:07 A.M.)
Great. Then you don't need to carry it to the car. Have them send it to the shop. I'll be there all day tomorrow to receive it.

Kwame Mensah (10:08 A.M.)
Sounds good. I'll pay now and give them our address.

questions.content: According to Mr. Mensah, what will end on Sunday?
questions.explanation: Lúc 10:05 Mr. Mensah viết: 'it's $40 off until Sunday' → mức giảm giá kết thúc vào Chủ nhật (B). (A) giao hàng miễn phí được nhắc nhưng không gắn với Chủ nhật; (C), (D) không được nhắc.

questions.content: At 10:04 A.M., what does Ms. Takeda most likely mean when she writes, "Gray is fine"?
options: She wants to go to the mall herself.
She thinks the printer is too expensive.
She will accept a different color.
questions.explanation: Mr. Mensah báo cửa hàng chỉ còn màu xám, không có màu trắng; Ms. Takeda trả lời 'Gray is fine' → bà chấp nhận màu khác (C). (B) sai vì bà hỏi tiếp về giảm giá, không chê đắt; (D) sai vì đây đúng mẫu họ muốn; (A) không có căn cứ.

questions.content: What is suggested about Ms. Takeda?
options: She plans to work at the shop tomorrow.
She is employed at Lakeside Mall.
She wants to pick up the printer herself.
She has already paid for the printer.
questions.explanation: Câu suy luận. Lúc 10:07 Ms. Takeda viết 'I'll be there all day tomorrow to receive it' (there = the shop) → suy ra ngày mai bà sẽ có mặt làm việc ở cửa hàng (A). (B) sai vì Mr. Mensah mới là người đang ở trung tâm thương mại; (C) trái với 'Have them send it to the shop'; (D) sai vì Mr. Mensah nói 'I'll pay now'.
